content: Tumor infiltrating stromal reaction refers to the presence of stromal cells within the tumor microenvironment. These stromal cells include fibroblasts, immune cells, endothelial cells, and other cells that play a role in the tumor progression. The interaction between tumor cells and stromal cells can impact tumor growth, invasion, and metastasis. Studying tumor infiltrating stromal reaction in histology can provide important insights into the biology of the tumor and help guide treatment strategies.
